title: Receptionist/Construction Secretary
description:
Receptionist/Construction Secretary

My client is an established and highly regarded housebuilder delivering high-quality new-build homes across the UK. With a strong reputation for creating attractive, sustainable communities, they work closely with local authorities, landowners, housing partners and other stakeholders to deliver a diverse range of residential developments. As the business continues to grow, they are looking to strengthen their team with talented individuals who can contribute to the smooth running of their regional operations.

You will be based on the front desk, acting as the first point of contact for visitors, customers, contractors and suppliers, while also providing administrative support to the Construction team. Duties include:
- Act as the first point of contact for visitors, customers, contractors and suppliers, providing a friendly and professional welcome.
- Answer and direct incoming telephone calls, take messages and deal with general enquiries.
- Manage the reception area, ensuring it remains tidy, professional and welcoming at all times.
- Sign in visitors and maintain accurate visitor records in line with company procedures.
- Receive, sort and distribute incoming post, deliveries and correspondence.
- Arrange outgoing post, couriers and deliveries as required.
- Provide general administrative and clerical support to the wider office team.
- Provide occasional administrative support to the Construction team, while continuing to manage front desk responsibilities.
- Assist Site Managers and Construction staff with day-to-day administration and general office duties.
- Prepare, format and distribute letters, reports, documents and correspondence.
- Maintain accurate electronic and paper filing systems and ensure construction records are kept up to date.
- Update spreadsheets, databases and internal systems with relevant information.
- Assist with organising meetings, appointments and site visits.
- Take meeting notes and circulate information where required.
- Assist with purchase orders, invoices, deliveries and other construction-related administration.
- Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and other external contacts by telephone and email.
- Assist with the preparation, organisation and distribution of site and construction documentation.
- Help coordinate information between the Construction team, subcontractors, suppliers and the office.
- Carry out data entry and maintain accurate records.
- Handle confidential information appropriately and professionally.
- Prioritise front-of-house duties while completing administrative tasks during quieter periods.
- Work closely with the Construction, Sales and wider office teams to support the smooth running of the business.
- Provide a high level of customer service to colleagues, customers, contractors, suppliers and visitors.
- Undertake any other reasonable administrative duties required to support the office and Construction team

The ideal candidate will have excellent organisational skills and the ability to fully operate Microsoft Word/Excel and PowerPoint. You will have a professional attitude and approach to work, be confident, self-motivated and be flexible and adaptable within the team.

This will be a Monday to Friday role, based out of their office in Warrington, office hours 8.30am - 5.00pm.

Salary & Package on offer:
- Competitive salary
- 24 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Bonus schemes
- Lifestyle and corporate perks
- Health & well-being

- Coordinate the Cheshire Contribution ensuring an efficient process is in place, including on-site management to ensure successful completion of tasks on the day of events
- Create an operational guide including checklists, safety protocols, risk assessments inductions and ensure all necessary equipment to complete the tasks is available
- Undertake the planning, delivery and co-ordination of events, including the development of marketing materials, for those taking part to ensure successful attraction of suitable stakeholders, local communities and volunteers
- Recruit volunteers and local residents to undertake individual projects, identify trusted local hosts and convenors who can support activity on the ground and ensure ongoing liaison throughout the period of the work
- Work with partnerships such as the local authorities, public bodies and other organisations to co-create projects in high impact, high visibility locations.
- Build and maintain a good relationship across the partnership landscape to identify appropriate projects to undertake and involve all relevant parties as well as unlocking the resources, capacity and relationships required
- Act as the single point of contact for the 'Cheshire Contribution' programme, providing advice to those wishing to participate as well as those agencies wishing to support
- Working closely with the Comms team, promote and build awareness of the programme engaging with stakeholders, delivering briefings to appropriate audiences and ensuring effective utilisation of volunteers
- Produce reports on the effectiveness of the programme including numbers involved and positive case studies and liaise with Comms to push out key messaging to not only promote the work but with a view to supporting community cohesion
- Maintain an understanding of community cohesion issues, identifying new opportunities to develop and expand the project
- Assist in the development, maintenance and implementation of a Cheshire contribution policy and look to mainstream the work into that of the OPCC and wider partners

Experience, Qualifications & Skills

Prior Education and Experience
- Educated to Level 4 or equivalent relevant experience
- Significant experience of coordinating events & activities.
- Experience of working with volunteers.

Skills
- Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Applications
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with those internal and external to the organisation.
- Excellent planning and organisation skills.
